payout_quote: Answer quick surveys and earn Google Play credit with Google Opinion Rewards, an app created by the Google Surveys team... We'll then send you surveys around once a week, although it may be more or less frequent. You'll get a notification on your phone when a short and relevant survey is ready for you, and can receive up to $1.00 in Play credit for completing it. (Official Google Play listing, updated 22 Sep 2026) ... You are paid with credits in the Google Play Store, using the Play Store account associated with the email address you provide. (Official Opinion Rewards Help)
timing: Surveys arrive around once a week (more or less); credit lands in your Play balance right after each completed survey
eligibility: 18+; Android or iOS; Google account; available countries; surveys matched to your profile and activity
steps: Install Google Opinion Rewards from the Play Store/App Store
Sign in with your Google account and complete the profile questions honestly
Enable notifications (and location history if you want more survey invites)
Answer each short survey when notified - usually under a minute
Credit accrues in your Play balance after each completed survey (Android; this is Play Store credit, not cash)
catches: On Android this pays in GOOGLE PLAY CREDIT, not cash - you cannot transfer it to a bank; it only buys apps, games, movies and in-app items
Surveys come around once a week, sometimes less - this is pocket change, roughly a few dollars a month at best
Some surveys pay only a few cents; the $1.00 is a ceiling, not the norm
Dishonest or inconsistent answers get you fewer surveys - answer truthfully
biggest_catch: This is not cash on Android - it is Play Store credit you can never withdraw. Expect a few dollars a month in app-store money, not income.
